title: Teradata VantageCloud Delivers 427% ROI and 11-Month Payback, According to Nucleus Research ROI Guidebook

body_markdown: Teradata empowers enterprises to turn intelligence into autonomous action, grounding AI agents in deep business context and trusted data.
